title: Permanent Wave — EN/IT/PT (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar trilingual storytelling 102bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan vocal English Italian Portuguese language learning absurdist
lyrics:
[Intro - dry lounge piano]
A rabbit was found on a country road
Dazed and still in the afternoon sun
The driver stopped and searched the boot
And found a can from 1981

[Verse 1 - English]
Read the label, couldn't quite make it out
Thought it might be worth a go
Sprayed the rabbit with a generous coat
And waited to see what the results would show
The rabbit got up and started to wave
Ran off waving, stopped, and waved again
Waved from the distance, waved round the bend
Still waving now, somewhere down that lane

[Verse 2 - Italiano]
Il guidatore cercò nel bagagliaio
(The driver searched the boot of the car)
Trovò uno spray, lesse l'etichetta
(Found a spray can, read the label)
Spruzzò il coniglio con cura
(Sprayed the rabbit carefully)
Il coniglio si alzò e cominciò a salutare
(The rabbit got up and started to wave)
Salutò allontanandosi, si fermò, salutò ancora
(Waved going away, stopped, waved again)
Saluta ancora laggiù in fondo alla strada
(Still waving down the lane)

[Chorus - Português]
Onda permanente, onda permanente
(Permanent wave, permanent wave)
O coelho levantou e começou a acenar
(The rabbit got up and started to wave)
Correu acenando, parou, acenando de novo
(Ran off waving, stopped, and waved again)
Acenando ao longe, acenando pela curva
(Waved from the distance, waved round the bend)
Onda permanente — restaurador de cabelo
(Permanent wave — hair restorer)
Com onda permanente
(With permanent wave)

[Bridge - spoken, all three]
Hair Restorer — Restauratore di Capelli — Restaurador Capilar
With Permanent Wave — Con Onda Permanente — Com Onda Permanente
The rabbit was fine
Il coniglio stava bene
O coelho estava bem

[Outro - piano fading]
Remarkably well-groomed
Notevolmente ben curato
Notavelmente bem cuidado
Still waving
Ancora salutando
Ainda acenando
